chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Regarding water in which beasts urinate, dogs lap, and the junub performs ghusl: “Indeed, if it is the measure of a kurr, nothing makes it impure.”

key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in a state of major ritual impurity
key_terms.الْكِلَابُ: dogs that lap from the water
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: water under discussion in the legal ruling
key_terms.كُرٍّ: a legally significant measure of water

ai.seo_question: Does water become impure if animals urinate in it, dogs lap from it, or a junub bathes in it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a large quantity of water. It states that when water reaches the measure of a kurr, contact with such things does not render it najis.
